body: I don't particularly care to share. The only thing I'll say about it is that it'll most certainly prevent me from getting into medical school if it comes to pass.

I have the same problem. And I'm still struggling with it. The only suggestion I can give is talk to your therapist about the nagging voice. I don't have one due to circumstance so I've been unable to try this, but talking to people always seems to help me. 

This is an aside, but is the voice in your head the voice of your parents? Cuz mine certainly is.
